name: CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup
tier_rationale: National CERT (A8 definitions name CIRCL as trusted); P181 'Registry provider circl: tier trusted' (this service is split out of provider circl only for its own key and budget) and P194 'trusted - CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup'.

reliability.justification: Aggregates authoritative vulnerability records (CVE 5 records, GHSA, PySec, CSAF) with EPSS; sightings are community observations kept apart from CISA KEV (P181).

circl_vuln.description: CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup API key (optional; keyless access works)
circl_vuln.plan_hint: optional account on vulnerability.circl.lu created under the corporate identity (A15); the data stays 'open' with or without it

api.title: Vulnerability-Lookup API (vulnerability by CVE/GHSA/PySec/CSAF id, EPSS, sightings, CWE; legacy cve.circl.lu alias)

terms.quote: Registry provider circl: tier trusted, terms open (CC BY 4.0 where applicable, attribution).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P181 cond 1). This provider is that service (split from circl for its key and budget). /api/vulnerability/{id} (CVE, GHSA, PySec, CSAF ids), /api/epss/{cve}, /api/sighting/?vuln_id=, /api/cwe/{id}; legacy alias cve.circl.lu/api/cve/{cve} (research C0428). 404 -> EMPTY; one shared CVE JSON 5 parser (P181). Attribute CIRCL (CC BY 4.0 where applicable).

vuln_pages.title: Vulnerability-Lookup pages /vuln/{cve} (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Registry provider circl: tier trusted, terms open (CC BY 4.0 where applicable, attribution).

vuln_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P181 cond 1). Manual links vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/{cve} (P194 entries, verified; research C0451). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G08-1, p2-G14-1: batches only extend it (circl_vulnlookup__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Quota: x-ratelimit-limit 20 per 60 s with retry-after 60 on /api/vulnerability (research C0428, observed keyless) -> rate 0.3333/s (published false, 80% budget) and min_interval 3 s; per-CVE calls follow the P183 fan-out budget.
